ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee and notify the rider that the driver's arrival, wait and contact attempts are documented; no refund is due.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the complaint, chats and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is no_show, so the screen returns none and a normal ruling follows.

The driver cancelled and selected rider_no_show [F4], so NS-1 governs [NS-0]. Every NS-1 condition holds. (i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:57:00 and the platform recorded arrival then; his GPS position was 40 m from the pickup point, well within the 200 m radius, and his closest approach was 38 m [F1][F6][F7]. (ii) Free wait: the 5-minute wait is counted from the later of the scheduled pickup time and arrival — here arrival 12:57:00 — and the wait ran 6 min 0 s (6 min 15 s cumulative within 200 m) before cancellation at 13:03:00 [F2][F3][F6][F7]. (iii) Contact: before cancelling the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 12:57:30) and made 1 in-app call (first 12:58:30), satisfying "≥1 message and ≥1 call" [F5][F10][F11][F13]. (iv) Continuous presence: the driver was stationary at 40 m from the pickup from 12:57:00 to 13:03:00, and no GPS gap leaves this unproven [F3][F7]. Because all four conditions hold, the $5.00 fee stands [F8] and no refund is payable under NS-2. The driver's app-selected reason is corroborated by his own chat words ("Waited more than 5 min, cancelling") and statement [F11][F14], so NS-3 (cancellation for another reason) does not apply; the rider's "I came out a minute after the driver cancelled" is a statement at odds with the timeline and does not displace the system records. Surge was 1.0x, so no surge element arises [F9]. Rider profile: 2 no-show cancellations in 30 days, below the NS-9 threshold of 3, so no rider flag_account; driver has 2 upheld prior no-show disputes, but RD-6 concerns route deviations and the no-show clauses carry no repeat-driver flag, so no flag is added [F18][F19]. $5.00 is a fixed no-show cancellation matter decided by the system (TH-2), and no missing record leaves any element undecidable [F12].

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at pickup within 200 m (NS-1(i))
element_findings.reason: "I'm Here" tapped 12:57:00 with GPS 40 m from pickup; closest approach 38 m — within the 200 m radius.
Wait counted from arrival 12:57:00; 6 min 0 s elapsed before the 13:03:00 cancellation, exceeding 5 minutes.

element_findings.element: Driver sent ≥1 in-app message and made ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: 2 timestamped in-app messages (first 12:57:30) and 1 in-app call (12:58:30), both before the 13:03:00 cancellation.

element_findings.element: Driver remained at the pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: Stationary at 40 m from the pickup for the full 6 minutes, within 200 m the whole time; no GPS gap.

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0: no-show vs another reason)
element_findings.reason: App reason rider_no_show, corroborated by his chat "Waited more than 5 min, cancelling" and his statement — a genuine no-show cancellation, not another reason under NS-3.
2 no-show cancellations in the last 30 days — below the 3-in-30-days flag threshold.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says she came out a minute after cancellation, but the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:57:00, waited 6 minutes with two messages and a call, and the 5-minute free wait had long expired [F2][F5][F6][F7]; system timeline overrides the statement.
